source_name: PrivatBank — Умови та Правила надання банківських послуг (conditions-and-rules portal)
why_relevant: The bank's master public offer, versioned by section. Section 1.1.5 explicitly governs how amendments are made and notified; diffing versions reveals exactly which rules changed and when, and the accompanying notice text often cites the driving NBU act or law.

State savings bank publishes recurring 'Шановні клієнти!' notices announcing amendments to the ДКБО (comprehensive banking service agreement) and tariffs with explicit effective dates — a reliable implementation-timing signal.

source_name: Oschadbank — ДКБО and consumer-information PDFs (uploads directory)
why_relevant: The dated ДКБО and 'Загальна інформація для споживачів фінансових послуг' PDFs carry a valid-from date in the filename, giving a machine-readable timeline of when regulatory-driven terms took effect.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine (Aval) — 'Актуальна інформація про роботу банку'
why_relevant: Operational-status page that historically documents restrictions imposed by NBU wartime resolutions (e.g. Western Union transfers suspended per p.17 of NBU Board Resolution No.18 of 24.02.2022) — a rare case of a bank naming the exact regulatory instrument.

source_name: Raiffeisen Bank Ukraine — оголошення PDFs (storage/files) on tariff & rules changes
why_relevant: Standalone 'оголошення' PDFs state which Rules/Tariffs change and the exact date they take effect (e.g. from 26.06.2025, from 02.10). Highest-density source of implementation dates for this bank.

source_name: OTP Bank Ukraine — 'Повідомлення про зміни' news items
why_relevant: OTP publishes formally titled notices ('Повідомлення про зміни у публічному договорі про видачу та обслуговування платіжних карток') with the effective date in the body — a clean, structured stream of terms-change events.

source_name: OTP Bank Ukraine — legal PDFs (approved-by-order documents)
why_relevant: Terms documents carry 'Затверджено наказом №… від …' headers, letting an analyst date internal approval versus public effective date — a proxy for how long the bank took to implement a rule.

source_name: UKRSIBBANK — News posts on service-condition changes
why_relevant: BNP Paribas-affiliated bank posts dated announcements changing card/savings and acquiring conditions; useful for comparing a foreign-owned group's implementation timing against domestic peers.
Rules PDFs are captioned 'Додаток N до Наказу від DD.MM.YYYY № H-LEG-YYYY-NN', giving an unusually precise, serialised internal-change log that can be tracked over time.

source_name: Universal Bank (monobank) — Умови і правила обслуговування
why_relevant: monobank's public offer is versioned as dated PDFs (umovy-YYYY-MM-DD.pdf), making the amendment cadence directly measurable; the neobank is usually among the fastest implementers of NBU payment-rule changes.

source_name: Universal Bank — corporate news & tariff-change announcements
why_relevant: The licensed legal entity behind monobank publishes the formal tariff-change notices (retail and legal entities) that the app itself does not surface.

source_name: PUMB (FUIB) — Presscenter › Notifications (Повідомлення про зміни у Публічній пропозиції)
why_relevant: Largest private domestic bank; maintains a dedicated, sequentially-numbered notifications feed exclusively for amendments to its public offer — arguably the single best-structured bank-side terms-change stream in Ukraine, and a strong peer benchmark even though PUMB is outside the named six.

source_name: Ukrgasbank — public offer / rules documents and unilateral-amendment acts
why_relevant: State bank publishing 'односторонній правочин' amendment acts with explicit effective dates; complements the private-bank sample for state-vs-private implementation-timing comparison.

source_name: Minfin.com.ua — bank company pages and news aggregation
why_relevant: Aggregates per-bank news including tariff/terms changes (e.g. Ukrsibbank card and savings tariff change coverage), often surfacing notices faster than the banks' own listings and providing a cross-bank monitoring index.

source_name: RBI (Raiffeisen Bank International) — Investor Relations: annual reports and regulatory disclosures
why_relevant: Parent-group Pillar 3 and annual reporting discusses the Ukrainian subsidiary's regulatory environment, capital/FX restrictions and compliance costs in English — the only channel where Ukrainian supervisory pressure is explained to an international investor audience.

source_name: OTP Bank Ukraine — English site and social channels (Viber/Telegram/Facebook notice mirrors)
why_relevant: The bank explicitly directs customers to its Viber/Telegram/Facebook channels for tariff- and credit-rule change news; these mirrors sometimes carry notices earlier or in shorter form than the website, and the English site gives EN terminology for the same events.

Not a bank source, but the regulator-side anchor needed to link a bank's customer notice to the specific resolution and its deadline; used here purely as the join key for bank-side implementation timing.
